            if out[horizontal_r][c] == 1:
                out[horizontal_r][c] = 2
        if out[target_r][target_c] != 2:
            out[target_r][target_c] = 2
        cur_r, cur_c = target_r, target_c

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    markers=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if grid[r][c]==2]
    start,end=markers
    centers=[]
    for r in range(H):
        counts=Counter(grid[r])
        special=[color for color,n in counts.items() if n==3 and color not in (1,2)]

            color=special[0]
            cs=[c for c in range(W) if grid[r][c]==color]

def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    global_counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    path_color=next(color for color,n in global_counts.items() if n==2)
    markers=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if grid[r][c]==path_color]
    start,end=markers
    background=global_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    centers=[]
    for r in range(H):
        counts=Counter(grid[r])
        special=[color for color,n in counts.items() if n==3 and color not in (background,path_color)]
        if special:
            cs=[c for c in range(W) if grid[r][c]==special[0]]
            centers.append((r,cs[1]))
    centers.sort()
    cur_r,cur_c=start
    for target_r,target_c in centers+[end]:
        horizontal_r=target_r-1
        for r in range(min(cur_r,horizontal_r),max(cur_r,horizontal_r)+1):
            if out[r][cur_c]==background: out[r][cur_c]=path_color
        for c in range(min(cur_c,target_c),max(cur_c,target_c)+1):
            if out[horizontal_r][c]==background: out[horizontal_r][c]=path_color
        out[target_r][target_c]=path_color
        cur_r,cur_c=target_r,target_c
    return out

source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    global_counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    path_color = next(color for color, n in global_counts.items() if n == 2)
    start, end = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == path_color]
    background = global_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    centers = []
    for r in range(h):
        counts = Counter(grid[r])
        special = [color for color, n in counts.items()
                   if n == 3 and color not in (background, path_color)]
        if special:
            columns = [c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == special[0]]
            centers.append((r, columns[1]))
    centers.sort()
    cur_r, cur_c = start
    for target_r, target_c in centers + [end]:
        horizontal_r = target_r - 1
        for r in range(min(cur_r, horizontal_r), max(cur_r, horizontal_r) + 1):
            if out[r][cur_c] == background:
                out[r][cur_c] = path_color
        for c in range(min(cur_c, target_c), max(cur_c, target_c) + 1):
            if out[horizontal_r][c] == background:
                out[horizontal_r][c] = path_color
        out[target_r][target_c] = path_color
        cur_r, cur_c = target_r, target_c
    return out
'''
